prompt: Using the provided reference image as the base, expand it into a wider vertical lifestyle product photo. Keep the golden retriever being sprayed and the hand steadying its body, but zoom out to show the dog sitting happily in profile with its face visible. Add a second human hand holding a blue-and-white trigger spray bottle aimed at the dog, with a fine mist visibly spraying onto the fur. Set the scene in a warm sunlit forest campsite during golden hour, adding exactly 3 major new background elements: 1 olive-green canvas tent on the right, 1 small camping table behind the dog, and 1 softly blurred forest of tall trees. Make the product feel like an outdoor pet repellent spray advertisement; put small readable label text on the bottle: {argument name="product label" default="Outdoor Repellent Spray"} and a simple brand mark: {argument name="brand name" default="NIPIP"}. Use photorealistic shallow depth of field, warm backlighting, natural colors, crisp fur detail, and realistic water droplets/mist. Do not crop tightly like the reference; show the dog, both human hands, the spray bottle, and the campsite context clearly.
